result.brief: 构建 ARC-AGI-3 上人类与 LLM 智能体的思维出声轨迹数据集，标注机制识别、动作意图与信念修正，用于分析交互中世界模型的构建与更新。
result.reason: Dataset of human/LLM think-aloud trajectories on ARC-AGI-3 probing world-model building and belief revision, but it is a cognitive benchmark dataset, not a video/multimodal world model or representation method.
